title: Curve-Secondary
slide_intent: Give supporting movements a quieter arrival so they do not compete with the leading action.
strategic_value: The secondary ease-out can let DB’s concluding details settle without restarting the visual emphasis.
demonstration: A red square traverses the left field while a marker follows a curve that rises early and flattens near the end.
practical_value: Choose the supporting curve for a subsequent movement such as the logo in an ending.
